metadata.title: Artiline — Share AI artifacts with your team
metadata.description: HTML, Markdown, code. Private workspaces, public links, optional passwords. Export to share-ready images.

landing.noCard: NO CARD · MAGIC LINK · 30 SEC TO FIRST SHARE
landing.multiTenantBody: Isolated workspaces. One catalog per team. Magic-link invites.
landing.visibilityBody: Team only · team + password · public · public + password. 4 levels, no gradients.
landing.exportBody: HTML rendered to 1200×630 image. Ready for Slack, Twitter, decks.
landing.panelMock: ↑ MOCK · REAL DATA IN YOUR WORKSPACE
landing.pov: Your AI output deserves better than a screenshot in Slack.
landing.demoHint: Paste an artifact, see it render live, then claim the link. Nothing is saved until you sign up.
landing.demoPlaceholder: Paste HTML, Markdown, or code here…
landing.demoDropTitle: Drag in an HTML, Markdown, or code file
landing.tooBig: Too big for the demo (100 KB cap). The real thing handles more.
landing.externalBlocked: External scripts and styles are blocked in this preview. They load in your real workspace.
landing.heroH1: Stop sending screenshots of things that actually run.
landing.heroSub: Your AI generates live HTML. Paste it, watch it render in a sandbox, and claim a locked link. 30 seconds, no card.
landing.s2H: The output dies in the tab.
landing.s2Body: You generate something that works: a hero with hover states, a prototype, a brief. To show it, you flatten it to an image, paste it in Slack, and wait. They ask for the new version. You resend. Another capture. Living work became a dead PNG in a thread.
landing.s2Msg3: is there a new version of yesterday's?
landing.s3H: From the AI's pane to a link, in four states.
landing.s3Step1B: HTML, Markdown, or code. Drag the file or paste the text.
landing.s3Step2B: Runs in an isolated sandbox. You see it live, not a capture.
landing.s3Step3B: Choose who gets in. Out comes a link with your catalog number.
landing.s3Step4B: Reactions and comments roll in. Export to a 1200×630 PNG anytime.
landing.s4Sub: Four levels. You decide who opens the link.
landing.lvlTeamDesc: Workspace members only. No one else gets in, even with the link.
landing.lvlTeamView: Anyone outside the workspace sees a sign-in screen, not your artifact.
landing.lvlTeamPwDesc: Your team, plus guests with the password. For one-off collaborators.
landing.lvlTeamPwView: Outside the team, the link asks for a password before showing anything.
landing.lvlPublicDesc: Anyone with the link. For showcases and social.
landing.lvlPublicView: Anyone opens the live artifact instantly, with the badge at the foot.
landing.lvlPublicPwDesc: Open link, but it asks for a password. For clients before the announcement.
landing.lvlPublicPwView: The link works for anyone, but asks for the password before revealing the work.
landing.s5H: Three ways to use it today.
landing.case1Body: You send the mockup, the CMO comments inside the artifact, and you approve without a fourteen-reply email thread.
landing.case2Body: The client opens the link with a password, sees the live prototype, and reacts. When you launch, you drop the password and it goes public.
landing.case3Body: The team leaves reactions and comments pinned to the design, not in a parallel Figma or three separate channels.
landing.s6Body: Every artifact runs in an isolated iframe with CSP default-src 'none'. No external scripts, no network calls, no access to cookies or your session. What you send a client can't phone home.
landing.s7H: Dozens of outputs a day, one catalog.
landing.s7Body: Every artifact arrives numbered, with type, size, views, and access level visible. No opening, no guessing. Catalog density, not cards with air.
landing.s8Body: Reactions and comments stay pinned to the artifact, not lost in Slack or an email chain. Whoever approves sees the same context you do.
landing.fbMsg1: Hero's there. Bump the weight on the CTA type and I'll approve it.
landing.fbMsg2: Approved. Make it public when the announcement drops.
landing.s9H: Open-core. Self-host free, or we host it.
landing.s9Body: The OSS edition is free and runs on your infra with every core feature. The cloud is for teams that don't want to maintain anything.
landing.ossDesc: All the core, on your infrastructure. Postgres and one container. No artifact limit.
landing.cloudDesc: We host it, back it up, and update it. More team features per license.
landing.madeWithNote: every public link carries the badge; your work distributes the product
landing.faqA1: In the demo, nothing: it clears on reload. In your workspace, only what you upload, in per-team isolated tenancy.
landing.faqQ2: Does it work with what I generate in v0, Cursor, Lovable, ChatGPT, or Claude?
landing.faqA2: Yes. If it's HTML, Markdown, or code, you paste or drop it and it's hosted.
landing.faqQ3: What if my artifact calls an external API?
landing.faqA3: In the preview it's blocked by the sandbox. In your workspace you adjust the policy by plan.
landing.faqA4: No. Magic link, no card, first share in 30 seconds.
landing.ctaFinalH: Your next output deserves a link, not a capture.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.subtitle: Connect Claude to your workspace via MCP. Generate a token, use it in the Claude Desktop extension, and create artifacts from any chat. Each token is scoped to this workspace and inherits your identity.
mcp.limitReached: You've reached the limit of {limit} active MCP tokens. Revoke one below to create another.
mcp.desktopIntro: The easiest way to connect. Download the extension, open it in Claude Desktop, and paste your token when prompted.
mcp.desktopStep1: Generate a token above and copy it.
mcp.desktopStep2: Download the extension and open it (double-click).
mcp.desktopStep3: Claude Desktop will ask for the «Artiline API token» → paste it. Done.
mcp.desktopHint: Requires Claude Desktop. Then, in any chat: «save this HTML to Artiline» → Claude calls create_artifact.
mcp.advancedDesc: For Claude Code (claude mcp add) or other MCP clients. The OAuth connector in Claude's web app has an open Anthropic bug and is unreliable today — use the extension above for Claude Desktop.
mcp.nameHint: A label to identify where it's used. Artifacts created with this token are attributed to you.
mcp.copyOnce: Copy it now. For security it won't be shown again — we only store a hash.
mcp.errNameLength: The name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.subtitle: OAuth applications (like the Claude.ai connector) you've granted access to this workspace. Revoking cuts the connection immediately.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Subscribe to your workspace events. Each delivery is signed with HMAC SHA-256 (header x-artiline-signature).
